title: Fieldwork interface audit
subject: Cross-view visual review
summary: A review of how Fieldwork’s shared shell, navigation and components line up across its research library. Follow the measured shifts from the first capture through two repair passes.

findings.title: Archive content shifts right
findings.observation: Archive adds left padding to the entire content area. The pane edge holds its position while the title moves inward.
findings.correction: Use the library’s shared content padding in Archive.
findings.criterion: Compare the title’s distance from the pane edge at each width.

findings.title: Settings widens the sidebar
findings.observation: At wider widths the Settings sidebar pushes both the pane and title to the right. The title’s local inset is stable.
findings.correction: Use the shared sidebar track width in Settings.
findings.criterion: Measure the pane edge and the title inset independently on wide and tablet.

findings.title: Returning to Inbox changes its inset
findings.observation: Following the Archive link back to Inbox moves the content relative to a direct Inbox visit. This shows up on the same page with the same data.
findings.correction: Apply the same content padding on direct and link arrivals.
findings.criterion: Travel through Archive again and compare the returned Inbox with direct entry.

findings.title: The Record toolbar loses space
findings.observation: Record intentionally adds a breadcrumb above the title. The toolbar also moves closer to the title, tightening a gap that other views share.
findings.correction: Restore the shared title-to-toolbar margin and keep the breadcrumb.
findings.criterion: Measure the toolbar gap and the intended 32 CSS px title shift on the same pair.

findings.title: The mobile header action moves inward
findings.observation: The workspace link shifts left in compact Settings because the header has extra trailing padding.
findings.correction: Restore the shared right inset on compact Settings.
findings.criterion: Compare the workspace link’s trailing edge across both views.

findings.title: The first Archive label slips half a pixel
findings.observation: In the compact Archive list, the first label moves slightly inside its own row. Measuring the row separately isolates that shift from the page padding.
findings.correction: Remove the label transform and keep the shared row padding.
findings.criterion: Check both directions on the compact profile at device scale 2.

findings.title: A folder label moves inside its row
findings.observation: The collection detail indents its first folder label farther than the corresponding collection tree row.
findings.correction: Apply the same local inset to folder labels in both trees.
findings.criterion: Compare the first label’s inset and check the neighboring control row.

findings.title: Empty search shifts the query text
findings.observation: On compact screens the empty result state adds an inset inside the search field.
findings.correction: Keep the query text on the same edge in both search states.
findings.criterion: Check the compact query inset and its control.

findings.title: Tag chips open an extra gap
findings.observation: On tag detail, the space between the swatch and its label grows within the first chip.
findings.criterion: Compare the chip’s local spacing across all captured profiles.

findings.title: The map legend crowds its key
findings.observation: The site detail’s legend draws the label closer to its key at wide and tablet widths.
findings.correction: Restore the shared spacing between the key and its label.
findings.criterion: Measure from the key’s trailing edge to the label.

findings.title: A compact table heading shifts
findings.observation: The first column heading in observation detail has extra padding on compact screens.
findings.correction: Use the shared header inset on the compact table.
findings.criterion: Compare the first heading’s distance from the column edge.

findings.title: The itinerary date sits low
findings.observation: The day number moves down inside a date badge on wide and tablet itineraries.
findings.correction: Restore the date number’s shared top inset.
findings.criterion: Compare the day number against the badge’s top edge.

findings.title: Member names pull away from avatars
findings.observation: The identity row adds space between a member’s avatar and name on the detail view.
findings.criterion: Compare the local gap at every measured width.

findings.title: A timeline marker misses its rail
findings.observation: The compact notifications marker lands left of the position used on the activity timeline.
findings.correction: Use the shared marker inset on the compact timeline.
findings.criterion: Compare the marker with its list edge and check the neighboring marker.

findings.title: A form hint loses its alignment
findings.observation: The new-note helper text starts farther from its field group than the matching preferences hint.
findings.correction: Use the shared hint inset for the new-note field.
findings.criterion: Compare the hint and field group on all measured profiles.

findings.title: The import action moves inward
findings.observation: The Import footer action has more trailing space than the corresponding Review action on wide and tablet.
findings.correction: Use the shared footer action inset.
findings.criterion: Compare the two action edges relative to their footers.

scope: Direct page entries and the return to Inbox through the Archive navigation link.
Shared shell edges, parent-relative spacing, stable controls and the intended Record breadcrumb shift.
limits: The layout passes measure settled views at the top of the page in Chromium. Transitions, browser Back and other engines remain outside this matrix.
Each profile uses the fixture’s supplied data. The component evidence covers the named anchors and checks.

related.label: Paint, content and focus checks
related.description: Review the icon, text contrast, compact identifier and keyboard focus ring. The companion report also checks intentional truncation, sticky table headers and mixed-direction text.

related.label: Blind visual discovery pilot
related.description: Read the independent reviewer’s submitted findings, examine their screenshot evidence and compare the submission with the fixture key.

related.label: Fieldwork Editions headline audit
related.description: Inspect individual letter pairs, whole-line tracking, and font substitution across seven editorial views. The typography handoff includes actual-size comparisons and the independently graded visual review.
